title: SDD Closure Actuals Record
description: Single closure actuals notebook written only by inception-pipeline closure-feedback after the SDD engine archives the change (it reads the engine's native archive-report, verify-report, and apply-progress; it does not modify the managed sdd-archive skill). Read by roadmap-maker and sdd-time-estimation for calibration. Eliminates dual-notebook drift (seam S5).

change_name.description: Kebab-case change slug, inherited from entry contract.

project.description: Project identifier, matching the entry contract.

implementation_hours.description: Actual hours spent in implementation (apply phase).

review_gate_hours.description: Actual hours spent in review gates (verify phase + PR review).

total_wall_clock_hours.description: Total elapsed calendar-clock hours from the tiering go-ahead checkpoint to merge, including interruption gaps (e.g. provider rate/session limits). Merge, not archive: post-merge archive-authorization lag is bookkeeping and MUST NOT count as development time. Measured independently of the agent-compute-time phase fields (implementation_hours, review_gate_hours, post_review_fix_hours) below and never blended into their sum. MUST NOT be in the schema's required list (R-021): omit rather than estimate when its anchors do not resolve.

post_review_fix_hours.description: Hours spent on post-review fixes after the initial verify pass.

approval_decision.description: Final approval outcome (e.g. approved, approved-with-notes, rejected).

scope_drift_notes.description: Free-text notes on any scope changes discovered during implementation.

variance_vs_plan.description: Summary of actual vs planned hours variance and contributing factors.

requirement_count.description: Optional. Number of EARS requirements (R-NNN) in the change's spec, read from sdd/{change}/spec. Complexity-unit divisor for sdd-time-estimation's agent-compute-time-per-requirement calibration rate. Omit if the spec could not be read.

changed_lines.description: Optional. Actual realized changed-line count at archive (e.g. a diff-stat total against the base commit, or the archive-report's recorded total). Do NOT source this from sdd/{change}/tasks's Review Workload Forecast — that figure is a pre-implementation planning guard, not an exact diff count (see sdd-tasks/SKILL.md). Complexity-unit divisor for the agent-compute-time-per-changed-line calibration rate. Omit if not available.

review_lens_count.description: Optional. Number of review lenses actually run during the review gate (0, 1, or up to 4 under the 4R tier) — the length of `selected_lenses` in the native `gentle-ai.review-receipt/v2`, if one exists for this change. Complexity-unit divisor for the review_gate_hours calibration rate. Omit if not available.

checkpoint_count.description: Optional. The total human-confirmation checkpoint count for the change, one unit per distinct human round-trip reply, counted uniformly regardless of how many decisions a single reply resolved. Shares the tiering-go-ahead-to-merge boundary with total_wall_clock_hours. Always includes the durable floor read from sdd/{change}/pipeline-state (tiering go-ahead, always 1; ambiguity clarifying question if fired, 0-1) — the only checkpoints inception-pipeline itself durably records. Also includes checkpoints inception-pipeline has no durable record of (mid-design product decisions, judgment-day rounds, chained-PR split confirmation, merge authorization) when reconstructable from the closure narrative. This single field does not distinguish durable from reconstructed provenance; that split is disclosed in variance_vs_plan free text. This is the real calendar-time driver for agent-orchestrated delivery, tracked separately from compute-time hours. Omit if not available.
